summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the working tree without running any code, and without committing. Changes: (1) src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (new) with Tab, TabsRenderable, and Tabs, exported via __all__; (2) src/textual/renderables/underline_bar.py adds clickable_ranges before width and returns one Text with click spans appended last; (3) src/textual/renderables/opacity.py merges the blended color into each segment's existing style so metadata survives; (4) docs/reference/tabs.md (new) with a single ::: directive for Tabs; (5) tests appended to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and new tests/widgets/test_tabs.py (+ empty __init__.py). The layout resolver was left unchanged because its Edge protocol already declares size, min_size, and fraction with the specified defaults. Judgment calls: the bar position is stored as a full-list index and mapped to displayed-tab positions by interpolation so the underline sits under the correct displayed tab with duplicate names; label padding uses the resolver only for flexible padding edges; inactive spans are dimmed individually so the active tab is not dimmed; letter search applies only to single-character keys; a hash was added to Tab; the sandbox demo was skipped as optional. Unverified: no tests were run. Risks to check first: existing exact-ANSI underline tests could shift if rich's Text render splits segments differently; new tests rely on rich merging click metadata into cell styles; widget construction in tests may create an asyncio Queue that touches the event loop on older Python versions.
